user.title: Advantage Air e-zone
user.description: Enter the address of the e-zone / MyAir / MyPlace wall tablet. It must run firmware v14 or later (local API on port 2025).

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the touch-screen tablet, e.g. 192.168.1.26. Give it a DHCP reservation so it doesn't move.
data_description.port: The tablet's API port. Leave at 2025 unless you know otherwise.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the touch-screen tablet.

error.unsupported_firmware: The tablet answered but doesn't offer the JSON API on this port. Update the tablet firmware, or check the port.
error.no_aircons: The tablet didn't report any aircons.

abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different e-zone tablet.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the tablet, in seconds. Changes made from Home Assistant are re-read about a second later regardless.

unsupported_firmware.message: The e-zone tablet doesn't support the JSON API: {error}

command_rejected.message: The e-zone tablet rejected the command: {error}

command_failed.message: Could not send the command to the e-zone tablet: {error}

unsupported_hvac_mode.message: This aircon doesn't support HVAC mode {mode}.

empty_scene.message: Scene {name} has no aircon settings to apply.
